name: firecrawl
description: Firecrawl CLI + client library: web search, page scrape to markdown, delayed batch, and a page-capped crawl behind --yes; every call audited and ceilinged, paid from the operator's own account
surface: read-only CLI (`fc`) and `lib/firecrawl.js`; search/scrape/batch run at once under in-code ceilings (20 results, 20 URLs, 1s delay floor); `crawl` previews its page/credit estimate and runs only with an explicit `--yes`, hard-capped at 50 pages in code; an audit line per HTTP request; no write, extract, map, webhook or account verb exists

origin.note: hello-* workshop repo (search + scrape client, examples, docs). The belt copy drops dotenv and the in-tree .env, adds fc.mjs, crawl with a page ceiling, the audit line, key-file/Keychain resolution and tests. Source tree was dirty (bun.lock only) at copy time; HEAD was taken

env.name: FIRECRAWL_API_KEY
env.description: Firecrawl API key (fc-…). Alternatives, in resolution order after the env var: ~/.config/toolbelt/firecrawl.key (mode 600 enforced), then the macOS Keychain item toolbelt-firecrawl. One of the three is required for any paid verb

auth.flow: Static API key from the operator's own Firecrawl account, read from $FIRECRAWL_API_KEY, a 600-mode key file, or the Keychain; sent as a bearer header, never on argv, never printed
auth.login: Create a key at https://www.firecrawl.dev (API Keys), then: security add-generic-password -s toolbelt-firecrawl -a "$USER" -w   (or write it to ~/.config/toolbelt/firecrawl.key and chmod 600)

caches.note: optional 600-mode key file; fc refuses group/world-readable permissions. The Keychain item toolbelt-firecrawl is the preferred store for this static secret
caches.revoke: Delete the key at https://www.firecrawl.dev → API Keys, then rm the file / security delete-generic-password -s toolbelt-firecrawl

safeguards: Read-only against the web: every verb is a search, scrape, crawl or status read; the only thing a call changes is the operator's own credit balance. No extract, map, webhook, batch-scrape-job or account-management code exists (SENSIBILITIES #1)

Ceilings are code constants in lib/firecrawl.js, refused rather than lowered when exceeded: MAX_SEARCH_LIMIT 20, MAX_BATCH_URLS 20, MAX_CRAWL_PAGES 50, MIN_DELAY_MS 1000 between sequential scrapes (SENSIBILITIES #3)

crawl is bulk private spend, flag tier: fc.mjs run() prints the page/credit estimate and exits 3 unless --yes is present; --yes is always honored. The page ceiling is sent server-side as `limit` (Firecrawl stops billing there) and enforced again client-side in collectPages() (SENSIBILITIES #2, #3)
--explain on every verb prints the exact method, URL, redacted headers and body, and sends nothing; it resolves no key so it works before setup (SENSIBILITIES #5)
One audit line to stderr per HTTP request — lib/firecrawl.js request(): timestamp, verb, target, HTTP status, byte size, elapsed ms — never the key, never the body (SENSIBILITIES #7)

Key from $FIRECRAWL_API_KEY, else ~/.config/toolbelt/firecrawl.key (resolveKey refuses mode & 077), else the Keychain item toolbelt-firecrawl; `status` reports the source and file mode only; redactHeaders() is the only header form that reaches stdout (SENSIBILITIES #6, #11)
No retries: 401, 402 (Firecrawl's out-of-credits AND its Hobby-plan rate-limit answer) and 429 each get one plain sentence and exit 1; batch is sequential with the delay floor (SENSIBILITIES #8, #9)

verbs.name: status
verbs.note: where the key lives and the ceilings; --live adds one unbilled credit-usage call

verbs.name: search
verbs.note: paid per result; --limit up to 20, default 5; site: in the query, --tbs qdr:h|d|w|m|y

verbs.name: scrape
verbs.note: one paid scrape of one URL; --format, --fresh (maxAge 0), --full (keep nav/footer)

verbs.name: batch
verbs.note: up to 20 URLs, sequential, --delay floor 1000ms default 2000ms; one failure does not abort the batch

verbs.name: crawl
verbs.note: bulk spend: previews the estimate and exits 3 without --yes; --yes always proceeds; hard-capped at 50 pages in code, server-side and client-side

verbs.name: crawl-status
verbs.note: one unbilled GET on a crawl job id

verbs.name: extract / map / batch-scrape job / webhooks / account management
verbs.note: exist in the Firecrawl API; no code here reaches them

risk.worst_case: credits spent from the operator's own Firecrawl account: at most 50 per crawl (--yes required), 20 per batch, 20 per search; arbitrary public URLs fetched by Firecrawl's servers, not from this host

checks.name: FIRECRAWL_API_KEY
checks.label: Firecrawl key present (env or 600-mode key file; a Keychain-only key shows here as absent but passes the live check below)
checks.fix: security add-generic-password -s toolbelt-firecrawl -a "$USER" -w   — or export FIRECRAWL_API_KEY, or write the key to ~/.config/toolbelt/firecrawl.key && chmod 600 it

checks.label: Firecrawl accepts the key (unbilled credit-usage read; reports remaining credits)

smoke_test.command: node fc.mjs crawl https://example.com --explain && node fc.mjs scrape https://example.com --explain && node --test test/*.test.mjs
smoke_test.expect: both pre-flights render the request with the bearer redacted and send nothing; unit tests green (ceilings, key-file refusal, redaction, crawl fence, audit shape, manifest/verb agreement) — no key, no network
